experiments.title: 流水灯与呼吸灯
experiments.goal: 掌握 51 单片机 I/O 数字输出与延时函数：用同一电路分别实现流水灯（基础任务）与呼吸灯（进阶任务，软件 PWM 调光），理解 PWM 占空比控制亮度的原理
experiments.goalEn: Digital output and delay functions on the 8051: implement an LED chaser (basic) and a breathing light (advanced, software PWM) on the same circuit, and understand duty-cycle brightness control.

experiments.title: 按键控制流水灯
experiments.goal: 掌握数字输入的读取方法：按键低电平有效、软件消抖、按住运行/松开停止的控制逻辑。
experiments.goalEn: Reading digital inputs: active-low buttons, software debouncing, run-while-pressed / stop-on-release control logic.

experiments.title: 矩阵键盘扫描
experiments.goal: 掌握行列扫描法：行线输出扫描、列线读取判断，理解 4×4=16 个键只需 8 根线的原理。
experiments.goalEn: Row–column scanning: drive the rows, read the columns — why 16 keys need only 8 wires.

experiments.title: 四位数码管动态扫描
experiments.goal: 掌握共阳数码管的段码原理与动态扫描显示（分时点亮 + 视觉暂留）。
experiments.goalEn: Common-anode 7-segment codes and dynamic scanning (time-multiplexed lighting + persistence of vision).

experiments.title: 定时器中断流水灯
experiments.goal: 掌握定时器 T0 方式 1 的初值计算与中断服务函数写法，理解"主循环 + 中断"的程序架构。
experiments.goalEn: Timer T0 mode-1 reload value calculation and ISR syntax; the "main loop + interrupt" foreground/background architecture.

experiments.title: 串口通信（UART）
experiments.goal: 掌握串口方式 1 的波特率计算（T1 方式2 初值）、串口收发寄存器 SBUF 与 RI/TI 标志的使用。
experiments.goalEn: Mode-1 baud rate calculation (T1 mode-2 reload value) and the use of SBUF with the RI/TI flags.

experiments.title: LCD1602 液晶显示
experiments.goal: 掌握 HD44780 时序：RS/RW/E 三根控制线的作用、指令与数据的区分、4 位/8 位接口，以及"写指令→等忙→写数据"的驱动流程。
experiments.goalEn: HD44780 timing: the roles of RS/RW/E, command vs. data, the 4/8-bit interface, and the write-command → wait-busy → write-data driver flow.

experiments.title: STM32 GPIO 流水灯与呼吸灯
experiments.titleEn: STM32 GPIO: LED Chasing & Breathing Light
experiments.goal: 掌握 STM32 GPIO 推挽输出配置与 HAL_GPIO_WritePin，理解与 51 准双向口输出方式的差异；进阶用 TIM PWM 或软件渐变实现呼吸灯
experiments.goalEn: STM32 GPIO push-pull output and HAL_GPIO_WritePin; how it differs from the 8051 quasi-bidirectional port; advanced: TIM PWM or software fade for a breathing light.

experiments.title: STM32 GPIO 流水灯与呼吸灯（F103C8T6）
experiments.titleEn: STM32 GPIO: LED Chasing & Breathing Light (F103C8T6)
experiments.goal: 掌握 STM32 GPIO 推挽输出配置与 HAL_GPIO_WritePin，理解与 51 准双向口输出方式的差异；进阶用 TIM PWM 或软件渐变实现呼吸灯
experiments.goalEn:
F103C8T6 variant: the MCU is STM32F103C8T6 (Blue Pill, LQFP48, Cortex-M3 72MHz, HSI 8MHz). Pins follow the same-position/different-name layout: PE0-PE7 in the F407 version correspond to PB0-PB7 here (identical symbol positions). Firmware must be regenerated after switching the device to STM32F103C8T6 in CubeMX/Keil (F1 and F4 register models differ; HEX images are not interchangeable).
STM32 GPIO push-pull output and HAL_GPIO_WritePin; how it differs from the 8051 quasi-bidirectional port; advanced: TIM PWM or software fade for a breathing light.

experiments.title: 示波器专项：双通道示波器测量练习
experiments.goal: 掌握数字示波器的基本操作——通道开关、时基（秒/格）、垂直档位（伏/格）、AUTO 与 RUN/STOP，能用测量读数量出方波的峰峰值与频率
experiments.goalEn: Basic digital-oscilloscope operation — channel on/off, timebase (s/div), vertical scale (V/div), AUTO and RUN/STOP — and measuring the peak-to-peak voltage and frequency of square waves.

experiments.title: STM32 按键扫描
experiments.goal: 掌握 GPIO 输入读取与软件消抖，理解内部上拉与外部上拉的选择。
experiments.goalEn: GPIO input reading and software debouncing; choosing between internal and external pull-ups.

experiments.title: printf 串口调试：重定向标准输出（STC）
experiments.titleEn: printf over UART: Redirecting Standard Output (STC)
experiments.goal: 掌握无调试器单片机的标准调试手段：实现 putchar 重定向，把 printf 格式化输出经串口发送到 PC 端，实时观察单片机内部变量与运行状态
experiments.goalEn: The standard debugging method for MCUs without a debugger: implement putchar redirection so printf sends internal variables and status to the PC over the UART, in real time.

experiments.title: STM32 外部中断 EXTI
experiments.goal: 掌握 NVIC 优先级配置与 EXTI 边沿中断回调，理解中断与轮询的差异。
experiments.goalEn: NVIC priority configuration and the EXTI edge-interrupt callback; interrupts vs. polling.

experiments.title: STM32 printf 重定向到串口

experiments.goalEn: The two printf redirection styles on STM32 (fputc / _write); MicroLIB and semihosting; streaming internal state to the PC over USART.

experiments.goalEn: USART1 parameter configuration, HAL UART transmit/receive and printf redirection.

experiments.title: 果园土壤监测与自动灌溉（综合设计）
experiments.goal: 综合运用 ADC 串行读取、LCD 显示、按键设定与滞环控制，完成"柚子果园土壤监测与自动灌溉"综合设计任务，理解真实场景中的工程控制策略。
experiments.goalEn: Combine serial ADC reading, LCD display, key setting and hysteresis control to complete a pomelo-orchard soil monitoring & auto-irrigation design task, and understand engineering control strategies in a real scenario.
